content.text:
{"dialogue": "Maya: ugh monday again, i'm dead
Leo: felt so long for no reason
Me: same, just got home and dropped my bag
Maya: did you actually leave on time for once?
Leo: asking the real questions
Me: lol no, stuck till like 5:40
Maya: damn, there goes the streak
Leo: my laptop was dragging all afternoon again
Me: mine too, i thought IT fixed yours?
Maya: nope still ghosted, mine froze twice today
Leo: did the sacred restart thing?
Maya: twice, didn't help
Me: i did three times last week and gave up
Leo: classic toolkit fail
Maya: leg day killed me this morning btw
Leo: you went this morning? on a monday?
Me: hardcore, are stairs gonna hurt tomorrow?
Maya: already hurt, send help
Leo: never go back to leg day
Me: hahaha still stuck in my head
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Leo: the crying suit guy lives on
Me: did you guys eat yet? i'm starving
Maya: not yet, thinking soup and toast again
Leo: grandma gang, i had cereal like an hour ago
Me: what kind this time?
Leo: same honey nut thing, i'm boring now
Maya: no judgment, cozy dinner
Me: i might do leftover pasta, i'm in a loop
Leo: join the pasta loop, it's safe here
Maya: okay so are we doing lunch this week at all?
Leo: i'm actually free this time, last week was chaos
Me: yeah i can do friday?
Maya: friday works for me, pizza?
Leo: yes please, wanna do pizza this Friday at noon?
Maya: yeah that works
Me: yeah that works for me too
Leo: nice, where tho? not Mario's again?
Maya: ugh no, those olives were way too salty last time
Me: yeah i loved the crust but that salt bomb killed me
Leo: exactly, i liked it otherwise but nah on olives
Maya: what about Luigi's on 5th Street?
Leo: oh yeah that works, i haven't been there in forever
Me: yeah that works, i can walk from work
Maya: perfect, i can bus over, it's easy
Leo: parking over there isn't awful right?
Me: way better than Pine Street, you'll be fine
Maya: meet out front like last time?
Leo: bet, i'll actually be on time this time
Me: famous last words
Maya: lol fr, text when you're close?
Leo: will do
Me: so friday noon still good for everyone?
Maya: yep!
Leo: yep, i'm in
Maya: can't wait, i need those garlic knots energy but different spot
Leo: does Luigi's do knots too?
Me: i think they do the little parmesan ones
Maya: omg even better
Leo: okay my kitchen is a mess again btw
Me: nooo you cleared the sink ecosystem!
Maya: reboot already?
Leo: rude but accurate, it lasted like four days
Me: new record at least?
Maya: growth is slow
Leo: i'll put that sketch on while i do dishes tonight
Me: same, endless dishes cycle over here
Maya: makes it go faster somehow
Leo: trailer voice makes everything dramatic
Me: never go back to workkkk while scrubbing pans
Maya: HAHAHA stop
Leo: anyone wanna do that cooking game later tonight?
Maya: maybe one round, depends how sore i get
Me: i could join for one, no promises i won't burn stuff
Leo: two fires max, house rule
Maya: hey that's my rule
Me: lol she owns it now
Maya: okay tea time, i'm freezing
Leo: get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for you, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers", "writer_note": "Kept the evening Monday tone and running jokes (tea orders, sink ecosystem, leg day, salty olives) to bridge the gap from Sept 26, then built a clear two-step agreement: Friday at noon first, then Luigi's on 5th Street, each with short explicit acceptances."}
